subject: Post-discovery: scheduling 30-min demo with FinBank
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@finbank.com>, Brian Lee <brian.lee@finbank.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Post-discovery: scheduling 30-min demo with FinBank

Hi Samira & Brian,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation and helpful context on the latency-sensitive fraud scoring use case and the need for predictable per-call economics. Quick recap:

- Primary use case: low-latency scoring (sub-250ms p50) for enrichment calls inside our transactions pipeline.
- Expected Q2 volume: ~250k requests/day initially with growth to 1M/day within 6-9 months.
- Key constraints: latency SLOs, SOC2/data residency questions, and price-per-1k inference cost.

Next step: we'd love to run a 30-minute product demo / technical intro to show the serving runtime, routing/fallback options, and how we measure cost/latency. Can you confirm who should join from your side? I recommend including the engineering/infra lead and whoever owns procurement for the initial pricing discussion.

A few time options (all ET) — pick one that works and I’ll send a calendar invite:
- Tue, Feb 27 — 10:00-10:30 AM ET
- Tue, Feb 27 — 2:00-2:30 PM ET
- Wed, Feb 28 — 11:00-11:30 AM ET

If none of these work, tell me two windows that do and we’ll adapt. I’m copying Vanessa (solutions engineer) and Marissa (AE) who will run the demo.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai

I’ve attached our 1-slide intro deck to help orient stakeholders before the call. If there are specific security/residency artifacts you want up front, tell me and I’ll share them (SOC2 summary, retention policy, and KMS integrations).
